title: 🐶 Loving Dogs Ready for Adoption in Ft Lauderdale Shelters
text:
7 hours ago Looking for a four‑legged friend in Ft Lauderdale, FL ? These adoptable dogs are waiting at the Humane Society of Broward County for someone special to take them home.
VENUS Breed: Labrador Retriever mix Age: Young Gender: Female Color: Black Adoption Fee: $200 Shelter: Humane Society of Broward County Phone: (954) 989-3977 ext.6 This young Labrador Retriever mix girl is full of potential and ready to learn all about family life with you. Labs are known for being smart and eager to please, and Venus is just waiting for her chance to shine in a real home.
👉 Meet VENUS and apply to adopt on adoptapet
ROSCOE Breed: American Staffordshire Terrier Age: Adult Gender: Male Color: Gray/Blue/Silver/Salt & Pepper Adoption Fee: $200 Shelter: Humane Society of Broward County Phone: (954) 989-3977 ext.6 Roscoe is a handsome American Staffordshire Terrier with a striking blue-gray coat. This adult pup is hoping for a steady, loving home that will give him structure, walks, and plenty of affection.
